condo: Cheapest 3Br! FH! Within 1km to St. Andrews

history.summary: A marketing-named listing ("Cheapest 3Br! FH! Within 1km to St. Andrews") at $2.767M / $2,546 PSF for a 1,087 sqft 3BR near Potong Pasir MRT (530m) — a new-launch-tier FH project (Myra / Jui Residences-type product). Strong-school proximity is the hook, but the PSF is very high, built_year and URA data are absent.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine positives: freehold, within 1km of St Andrew's school (a real own-stay/rental draw), and just 530m to Potong Pasir MRT — the sub-500m-ish band that supports value. But $2,546 PSF is full new-launch pricing in D12, the $2.767M quantum on a compact 1,087 sqft 3BR is high for the city-fringe segment, and the dossier gives no project name, no built_year and no URA appreciation/transaction data to verify the trajectory. The opacity plus rich PSF prevents a buy; the school catchment and MRT proximity prevent an avoid.
